shared_elements: a horizontal band of repeated pattern
a row/frieze of figures aligned along a common ground line
justification: Both surfaces organise profile quadrupeds into a horizontal row set against a band of repeated pattern, and both include a foliate/branching motif and a disc, which is the most specific correspondence. Beyond that generic scheme they diverge sharply: A is a smoothly finished, naturalistically modelled procession with human figures on a flat wall panel, while B is a coarse, schematic, deeply blocked-out carving with abstracted creatures wrapped around an irregular upright block.
